normalized.description: The European Commission wants to contribute to improving transport security and the protection of transport users and staff against terrorist and cyber-attacks for all modes of the European transport sector (Aviation, Maritime and Land Transport). The project described in this call will aim at developing a working interactive toolkit providing the relevant and appropriate knowledge of good cyber-security practice available to transport managers managing cyber-security risks and also to all transport staff who need to be aware of the potential risks. The toolkit will contain recommended good practices covering both generic aspects of cyber-security and in addition more specific modules related to the needs of each transport mode.
